items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Captain Joe Streckfus was the president, see... Got me to come on the boat... We played every night in St. Louis on the steamer St. Paul.

ctx.x: Guitar. Well he played piano out there. No, he played guitar because he had two guitars and two, because Steve Lewis was on piano. Steve Lewis. Yeah. Well I quit the job out there because I didn't like the way he was serving the fish and stuff that they supposed to give us. I didn't like the way he was serving. And he was giving us a nice way to go. I quit. So I quit like on a Wednesday night, and the whole band quit that Saturday night. So I'm sitting down home. So Peter Bocars and Captain Johnny come to the…
Well, he must have been a pretty old man by this time. Huh? Charlie McCurdis was pretty old probably by this time.
